about: Review metadata: the type of each SY item's irrelevant (padding) fact, for the padding-variety content check (lib/drills/content-checks.ts paddingTypeProblems). Every irrelevant fact must pass the partner test: interesting, but it doesn't change the answer.

types.neutral_number: a number outside the decision's math (category growth, customer count)
types.sunk_cost: money already spent that the decision can't recover
types.history: when something happened (opened, built, launched, redesigned)
types.people: who works for, founded, designed or knows the business
types.location: where something is based or sits
types.operations_detail: how the business runs, unrelated to the decision (hours, materials, leases)
types.outside_context: facts about the market or place outside the business
